name: Othniel
whenBasis: The period of the judges, which Judges does not date. Counting back from 1 Kings 6:1's 480 years gives the late 1400s–1100s BC for the whole period; an exodus under Ramesses II gives a later, shorter one.
summary: Son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, who took Kiriath-sepher (Debir) and won Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife. When Israel served Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim eight years, the Spirit of the LORD came on him; he judged Israel and prevailed, and the land had rest forty years.
body: Judges gives his story as the pattern for all that follow: Israel does evil, the LORD sells them into an enemy's hand, they cry out, the LORD raises up a deliverer, the Spirit comes on him, and the land has rest until he dies.
Nothing more is told of him, and no speech of his is recorded.
